europe_now.title: Russia preparing massive strikes on Ukraine's energy infrastructure
europe_now.summary: Ukrainian officials warned that Russia is preparing large-scale strikes targeting energy facilities, raising the threat of further infrastructure damage and disruption to power supplies. The alert comes amid ongoing attacks that have already strained Ukraine's energy grid ahead of winter.

sources.headline: Russia preparing ‘massive strikes against Ukraine’s energy facilities’

europe_now.title: Manhunt after deadly shooting at Swiss rave
europe_now.summary: Police in Switzerland launched a manhunt after a shooting at an outdoor rave killed one woman and injured five others, prompting a cross-cantonal search for the suspect. Authorities are treating the attack as a major security incident under investigation.

sources.headline: Manhunt after shooting at Swiss rave kills woman, 22, and injures five
Gunman kills one at Swiss rave party

top_stories.title: Iceland rejects restarting EU accession talks
top_stories.summary: Icelanders voted in a referendum against resuming negotiations to join the European Union, leaving the country's membership path on hold. The result reflects sustained public skepticism toward deeper integration with the bloc.

sources.headline: Iceland votes against restarting talks on joining EU
🔴 Iceland rejects restarting EU accession talks in referendum

top_stories.title: Greece and Turkey clash over Aegean marine protections
top_stories.summary: Greece and Turkey are engaged in a diplomatic dispute over protected maritime zones in the Aegean Sea, with each side contesting the other's environmental and territorial claims. The disagreement risks escalating tensions between the two NATO neighbors.

sources.headline: Greece, Turkey clash over protected Aegean marine areas

top_stories.title: Norway's new king addresses the nation after succession
top_stories.summary: Norway's newly ascended monarch delivered his first public address to the nation, paying tribute to his late father following the transfer of the throne. The speech marked the formal beginning of a new era for the Norwegian royal family.

sources.headline: Norway's new king remembers 'my dear father' in first speech

top_stories.title: Serbia weighs EU and Russia ties ahead of election
top_stories.summary: Serbia is balancing its relationships with the European Union and Russia as campaigning intensifies ahead of upcoming national elections. Officials face pressure from both blocs on issues ranging from sanctions to energy cooperation.
